title: Governance threads and decisions
description: Use when a scope/business decision must be raised or recorded in an LPM governance thread (requirement, baseline, roadmap item), for the decision inbox (decisões pendentes), or to turn a decided thread into an activity, requirement or change set. Not for deciding a change request (use lpm-roadmap).
doneWhen: The re-read shows the expected status and decisionOutcome, with actionTargetId once an artifact exists.
authorityCeiling: Reads, threads, replies and notes [A]; thread status, decider or title [C]; recording, reopening and linking a decision [O], only on the decider's order.
jobs:

notFor.when: reviewing or applying a roadmap change request
progress, evidence or closure of one activity

configuring budgets, pools or AI models

references.loadWhen: playbook triage: pending decisions of one project
playbook open-thread: open a thread asking for a decision
playbook reply: reply in a thread
playbook update-thread: change a thread's status, decider or title
playbook reopen: reopen a decided thread
playbook record-decision: record a decision, or ask the decider to confirm it
playbook create-artifact: create or link a decided artifact
playbook activity-note: a note on one activity
background: thread model and the LPM limits the playbooks route around

codex.shortDescription: Raise, record and act on LPM governance decisions
codex.defaultPrompt: Use $lpm-governance-decisions to triage the pending governance decisions of LPM project <projectId>.
